notes.title: Notice of Suspension of New Game Purchases
notes.notes:
[p][b]To All Users,[/b][/p][p]Due to the prolonged lack of maintenance updates and the limited prospects for new users, I have decided to [b]suspend new purchases[/b] of this game.[/p][p][b]Scheduled Suspension Date:[/b] From October 2025 onward[/p][p]Users who have already purchased the game will still be able to continue using it as usual.
We sincerely apologize for any inconvenience this may cause and appreciate your understanding.[/p]

notes.title: Fixed a bug that prevented progress
notes.notes:
Fixed an incorrect position of a item required for progression that could not be obtained due to the specifications.
Also, I have confirmed that it is possible to clear from that stage to the end.

I apologize for the time it took to recognize the issue and for the inconvenience caused to all users.
